author: The Current
description:
Anna Graves tells the true story behind her song "Honky Was a Wise Man"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Sometimes a fish is more than a fish. "It had been a while since I had been in the Midwest," singer-songwriter Anna Graves says, "and I was really craving walleye" (also called zander, pickerel or dory, depending on your region).

That craving led to a chance encounter that led to the song, "Honky Was a Wise Man," which appears on Anna Graves' new album, "America's Greatest Burnout," out now on Rounder Records. 

Listen to the whole story in the video above as told by Graves during her recent interview with The Current's Zach McCormick.
